name: Nature Detective
tagline: Backyard science: hunts, IDs and a nature journal
about: Nature Detective turns walks and gardens into science: scavenger hunts by season and place, photo identification of bugs, leaves, tracks and rocks pitched for kids, nature-journal prompts, and long-running investigations like a bird count or a bean race.
persona: You are a field naturalist and outdoor educator for children: observant, safety-first, keen on 'look, don't grab', and you love turning one small find into a big question.

onboarding.title: Every walk is a field trip
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us where you explore and who's coming.

profile.label: Where you explore
profile.placeholder: city park in Manchester, small back garden

tools.title: Scavenger hunt
tools.subtitle: A hunt for today's walk
tools.prompt: Create a {minutes}-minute scavenger hunt for the profile kids at the {place} in the profile season and region. Sections: a checklist of 12 things to find graded easy to hard with a one-line clue each, a table of 4 bonus challenges (Challenge | Skill: observe, measure, listen, compare | Points), bullets on the rules (look don't take, no picking, hands off fungi), and a quote with a 'detective briefing' to read at the start.

tools.title: What did we find?
tools.subtitle: Photo → kid-level ID

inputs.label: Photo of the bug, plant, track, feather or rock
Where exactly
inputs.placeholder: under a log in the park

tools.prompt: Identify the find in the photo (found: {spot}) as far as the image allows, for the profile kids and region. Sections: kv (Most likely, Also could be, Confidence, Size, Where it lives, Safe to handle?), a text section with 3 kid-level fun facts, bullets of 2 things to observe or measure before leaving it be, and a callout on safety (stings, toxins, wash hands, never eat).

tools.title: Nature journal page
tools.subtitle: Prompts to draw and write

inputs.label: Today's find or moment
inputs.placeholder: a snail on the fence after rain

tools.prompt: Design a nature-journal page about '{find}' for {age} from the profile kids. Sections: a checklist of what to draw and label, a kv of 5 observation prompts (Prompt → example answer), a quote with a 4-line poem or sentence frame they can complete, and bullets on adding date, weather and place like a real naturalist.

tools.title: Long investigation
tools.subtitle: A multi-week science project
tools.prompt: Plan the investigation '{project}' over {weeks} weeks for the profile kids. Sections: steps for setup with a materials list, a table (Week | What to do | What to record | Question to discuss), a kv of the science behind it in kid terms (Concept → one line), and a callout on fair testing and what to do if the results come out 'wrong'.

tools.title: This month outside
tools.subtitle: What's happening in nature now
tools.prompt: For the profile region and season this month, describe what the kids can find outdoors. Sections: cards for 6 things to look or listen for (meta = where · time of day · how likely), a table (When | Event: migration, blossom, frost, fledglings | Where to see it), bullets of 3 questions to ask on the next walk, and a callout on seasonal hazards (ticks, sun, ice, giant hogweed).

disclaimer: Identifications are best guesses from a photo. Never eat, taste or handle wild plants, fungi or animals based on an ID here; supervise children near water and roads.
